newsitem.title: HUNGARY: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 26.
newsitem.headline: HUNGARY NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 26.

text.p: These are the main headlines on Hungary's Kossuth Radio midday news. Reuters cannot vouch for their accuracy:
- Romanian state television plans to cut back Hungarian language programmes.
- The former Chairman of opposition party Smallholders says he saw proof that the present leader of the party, Jozsef Torgyan was an agent of Hungary' communist secret service.
- Police suspects a Turkish man of being responsible for last night's shootout in downtown Budapest.
- The second round of the agricultural roundtable talks of opposition parties has started.
